[0] Now, support counters. And the first one is Poppy. Her W can completely block out Alistar dashes which makes it impossible for him to combo.
[0] the moment he turns level two, he reaches his first power spike. And that's when he will look for allins.
[0] It's very important to know what exactly the headbutt range is of Alistar. This is his danger zone, and once you step foot in it, he will all in you.
[1] Reaction speed test, he can never engage if you hold your W for his, go aftershock/HoB and tank build. If he ever does land an engage, counter engage onto his adc immediately
[1] He'll try to stun you before dashing into you, so try to activate W before he CC's you to avoid his knockback. When he uses his R, try to disengage until its duration wears off.
[1] In lane, you can also R away the ADC when Ali engages, and kill Alistar 2v1. He will quickly feel pretty useless if you do.
[1] His W can be blocked, but it's really fast. Careful of his flash Q; if you don't W before the knock-up you will be very out of position.
[2] Poppy's W (Steadfast Presence) blocks Alistar's W (Headbutt) dash and knocks her up. If Poppy uses W, do not dash; wait or chain into another ability.
[2] Poppy's E (Heroic Charge) stuns if it hits a wall. When Poppy tries to use E, use Alistar's E (Trample) ghosting effect to avoid the wall slam, or push Poppy away with W.
[2] To not die lvl1 dont stand close to wall as it can burst you. Dont get baited by Mini Mundo passive.
[2] Poppy's W will stop you from engaging as it blocks all dashes including your W. Play around this or you will insta-lose your lane, because you can't play the game.
